# 023-hotel

**Provider.** Accor, booked on ALL.com (ALL - Accor Live Limitless) for a Mercure hotel, French.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts and a PDF confirmation attached (`Confirmation_2XR5T9CJ.pdf`). The email has the ALL header with the member card, the reservation number box, arrival and departure columns, stay details, price summary and cancellation terms. The PDF repeats the booking in the hotel's document style with numeric dates (`23/05/2027`), nightly lines, a two-column conditions block and practical information.

**Why.** French time notation ("à partir de 15h00", "jusqu'à 12h00") must become `15:00` and `12:00`, and the PDF uses a different date format from the email ("dimanche 23 mai 2027"). The sender is ALL while the provider is Accor and the hotel is a Mercure. The partially masked ALL loyalty card number appears in both parts and must not be taken as a reference. The total includes the taxe de séjour and is paid at the hotel. The PDF adds times that are not check-in or check-out times (breakfast hours, the guarantee "jusqu'au lendemain de votre arrivée à 12h00") and a second email address for the hotel reception.
